findings.title: Report Hub KPI thumbnails and Duplicate actions fail the bounded AA contrast sample in dark/light report-hub contexts

findings.baseline_comparison: Not in R1 authoritative broad audit; same ratios observed in the R1 custom replay, so the class persists and is newly made explicit for R2.

findings.title: Data First wafer-die probe does not recognize populated fab-matrix cells
findings.user_consequence: The maintained gate reports zero wafer dies and fails a critical evidence check even though the rendered Data First matrix has four cells; this produces a false red verification result.

findings.baseline_comparison: R1 reported the same zero-die/empty-wafer observation; R2 trace proves populated model→renderer state, narrowing the class to verifier coverage.
findings.minimum_next_action: Update acceptance probe to count the renderer’s fab-matrix marks; keep product source unchanged.
